text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board. The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews at its April 4, 2019 meeting and recommend four candidates to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board. Candidate #TZB1-35 Candidate #TZB1-197 Candidate #TZB2-11 Candidate #TZB2-38 Candidate #TZB2-48 Candidate #TZB2-53 Candidate #TZB2-58 Candidate #TZB2-63 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (March 12, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board.
